verses.ar: وَفِي أَوَّلِ ٱلْأُسْبُوعِ جَاءَتْ مَرْيَمُ ٱلْمَجْدَلِيَّةُ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ بَاكِرًا، وَٱلظَّلَامُ بَاقٍ. فَنَظَرَتِ ٱلْحَجَرَ مَرْفُوعًا عَنِ ٱلْقَبْرِ.
verses.kjv: The first [day] of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.web: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

verses.ar: فَرَكَضَتْ وَجَاءَتْ إِلَى سِمْعَانَ بُطْرُسَ وَإِلَى ٱلتِّلْمِيذِ ٱلْآخَرِ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ يَسُوعُ يُحِبُّهُ، وَقَالَتْ لَهُمَا: «أَخَذُوا ٱلسَّيِّدَ مِنَ ٱلْقَبْرِ، وَلَسْنَا نَعْلَمُ أَيْنَ وَضَعُوهُ!».
verses.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.web: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ بُطْرُسُ وَٱلتِّلْمِيذُ ٱلْآخَرُ وَأَتَيَا إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ.
verses.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.web: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ٱلِٱثْنَانِ يَرْكُضَانِ مَعًا. فَسَبَقَ ٱلتِّلْمِيذُ ٱلْآخَرُ بُطْرُسَ وَجَاءَ أَوَّلًا إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ،
verses.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.web: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

verses.ar: وَٱنْحَنَى فَنَظَرَ ٱلْأَكْفَانَ مَوْضُوعَةً، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ.
verses.kjv: And he stooping down, [and looking in], saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.web: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَاءَ سِمْعَانُ بُطْرُسُ يَتْبَعُهُ، وَدَخَلَ ٱلْقَبْرَ وَنَظَرَ ٱلْأَكْفَانَ مَوْضُوعَةً،
verses.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
verses.web: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

verses.ar: وَٱلْمِنْدِيلَ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ لَيْسَ مَوْضُوعًا مَعَ ٱلْأَكْفَانِ، بَلْ مَلْفُوفًا فِي مَوْضِعٍ وَحْدَهُ.
verses.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.web: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

verses.ar: فَحِينَئِذٍ دَخَلَ أَيْضًا ٱلتِّلْمِيذُ ٱلْآخَرُ ٱلَّذِي جَاءَ أَوَّلًا إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ، وَرَأَى فَآمَنَ،
verses.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.web: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَكُونُوا بَعْدُ يَعْرِفُونَ ٱلْكِتَابَ: أَنَّهُ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَقُومَ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ.
verses.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.web: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

verses.ar: فَمَضَى ٱلتِّلْمِيذَانِ أَيْضًا إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِمَا.
verses.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.web: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

verses.ar: أَمَّا مَرْيَمُ فَكَانَتْ وَاقِفَةً عِنْدَ ٱلْقَبْرِ خَارِجًا تَبْكِي. وَفِيمَا هِيَ تَبْكِي ٱنْحَنَتْ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ،
verses.kjv: ¶ But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, [and looked] into the sepulchre,
verses.web: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

verses.ar: فَنَظَرَتْ مَلَاكَيْنِ بِثِيَابٍ بِيضٍ جَالِسَيْنِ وَاحِدًا عِنْدَ ٱلرَّأْسِ وَٱلْآخَرَ عِنْدَ ٱلرِّجْلَيْنِ، حَيْثُ كَانَ جَسَدُ يَسُوعَ مَوْضُوعًا.
verses.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.web: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

verses.ar: فَقَالَا لَهَا: «يَا ٱمْرَأَةُ، لِمَاذَا تَبْكِينَ؟». قَالَتْ لَهُمَا: «إِنَّهُمْ أَخَذُوا سَيِّدِي، وَلَسْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَيْنَ وَضَعُوهُ!».
verses.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.web: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا قَالَتْ هَذَا ٱلْتَفَتَتْ إِلَى ٱلْوَرَاءِ، فَنَظَرَتْ يَسُوعَ وَاقِفًا، وَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ يَسُوعُ.
verses.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
verses.web: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهَا يَسُوعُ: «يَا ٱمْرَأَةُ، لِمَاذَا تَبْكِينَ؟ مَنْ تَطْلُبِينَ؟». فَظَنَّتْ تِلْكَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْبُسْتَانِيُّ، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، إِنْ كُنْتَ أَنْتَ قَدْ حَمَلْتَهُ فَقُلْ لِي أَيْنَ وَضَعْتَهُ، وَأَنَا آخُذُهُ».
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهَا يَسُوعُ: «يَا مَرْيَمُ». فَٱلْتَفَتَتْ تِلْكَ وَقَالَتْ لَهُ: «رَبُّونِي!» ٱلَّذِي تَفْسِيرُهُ: يَا مُعَلِّمُ.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهَا يَسُوعُ: «لَا تَلْمِسِينِي لِأَنِّي لَمْ أَصْعَدْ بَعْدُ إِلَى أَبِي. وَلَكِنِ ٱذْهَبِي إِلَى إِخْوَتِي وَقُولِي لَهُمْ: إِنِّي أَصْعَدُ إِلَى أَبِي وَأَبِيكُمْ وَإِلَهِي وَإِلَهِكُمْ».
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and [to] my God, and your God.
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

verses.ar: فَجَاءَتْ مَرْيَمُ ٱلْمَجْدَلِيَّةُ وَأَخْبَرَتِ ٱلتَّلَامِيذَ أَنَّهَا رَأَتِ ٱلرَّبَّ، وَأَنَّهُ قَالَ لَهَا هَذَا.
verses.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and [that] he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.web: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا كَانَتْ عَشِيَّةُ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ، وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ ٱلْأُسْبُوعِ، وَكَانَتِ ٱلْأَبْوَابُ مُغَلَّقَةً حَيْثُ كَانَ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ مُجْتَمِعِينَ لِسَبَبِ ٱلْخَوْفِ مِنَ ٱلْيَهُودِ، جَاءَ يَسُوعُ وَوَقَفَ فِي ٱلْوَسْطِ، وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «سَلَامٌ لَكُمْ!».
verses.kjv: ¶ Then the same day at evening, being the first [day] of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.
verses.web: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا قَالَ هَذَا أَرَاهُمْ يَدَيْهِ وَجَنْبَهُ، فَفَرِحَ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ إِذْ رَأَوْا ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them [his] hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ يَسُوعُ أَيْضًا: «سَلَامٌ لَكُمْ! كَمَا أَرْسَلَنِي ٱلْآبُ أُرْسِلُكُمْ أَنَا».
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace [be] unto you: as [my] Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا قَالَ هَذَا نَفَخَ وَقَالَ لَهُمُ: «ٱقْبَلُوا ٱلرُّوحَ ٱلْقُدُسَ.
verses.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on [them], and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
verses.web: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

verses.ar: مَنْ غَفَرْتُمْ خَطَايَاهُ تُغْفَرُ لَهُ، وَمَنْ أَمْسَكْتُمْ خَطَايَاهُ أُمْسِكَتْ».
verses.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; [and] whose soever [sins] ye retain, they are retained.
verses.web: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

verses.ar: أَمَّا تُومَا، أَحَدُ ٱلِٱثْنَيْ عَشَرَ، ٱلَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ ٱلتَّوْأَمُ، فَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ حِينَ جَاءَ يَسُوعُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.web: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ ٱلْآخَرُونَ: «قَدْ رَأَيْنَا ٱلرَّبَّ!». فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «إِنْ لَمْ أُبْصِرْ فِي يَدَيْهِ أَثَرَ ٱلْمَسَامِيرِ، وَأَضَعْ إِصْبِعِي فِي أَثَرِ ٱلْمَسَامِيرِ، وَأَضَعْ يَدِي فِي جَنْبِهِ، لَا أُومِنْ».
verses.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.web: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

verses.ar: وَبَعْدَ ثَمَانِيَةِ أَيَّامٍ كَانَ تَلَامِيذُهُ أَيْضًا دَاخِلًا وَتُومَا مَعَهُمْ. فَجَاءَ يَسُوعُ وَٱلْأَبْوَابُ مُغَلَّقَةٌ، وَوَقَفَ فِي ٱلْوَسْطِ وَقَالَ: «سَلَامٌ لَكُمْ!».
verses.kjv: ¶ And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: [then] came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace [be] unto you.
verses.web: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ لِتُومَا: «هَاتِ إِصْبِعَكَ إِلَى هُنَا وَأَبْصِرْ يَدَيَّ، وَهَاتِ يَدَكَ وَضَعْهَا فِي جَنْبِي، وَلَا تَكُنْ غَيْرَ مُؤْمِنٍ بَلْ مُؤْمِنًا».
verses.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust [it] into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.web: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ تُومَا وَقَالَ لَهُ: «رَبِّي وَإِلَهِي!».
verses.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
verses.web: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ يَسُوعُ: «لِأَنَّكَ رَأَيْتَنِي يَا تُومَا آمَنْتَ! طُوبَى لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَرَوْا».
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed [are] they that have not seen, and [yet] have believed.
verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

verses.ar: وَآيَاتٍ أُخَرَ كَثِيرَةً صَنَعَ يَسُوعُ قُدَّامَ تَلَامِيذِهِ لَمْ تُكْتَبْ فِي هَذَا ٱلْكِتَابِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.web: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا هَذِهِ فَقَدْ كُتِبَتْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا أَنَّ يَسُوعَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ ٱللهِ، وَلِكَيْ تَكُونَ لَكُمْ إِذَا آمَنْتُمْ حَيَاةٌ بِٱسْمِهِ.
verses.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
verses.web: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
